description: Knowledge graph schema that defines entity types (e.g., Equipment, Location), relationships between them, and data bindings to lakehouse tables. Used by Digital Twin Builder and Graph Models to create queryable knowledge graphs.

definition_parts.description: Item metadata (type/displayName); required for a full definition, respected on updateDefinition only with updateMetadata=true
Entity type: id (BigInt), namespace 'usertypes', name, entityIdParts, properties, timeseriesProperties, untypedProperties, baseEntityTypeId (inheritance)
Data binding linking entity to a LakehouseTable (NonTimeSeries) or KustoTable/Eventhouse (TimeSeries) source
Optional: linked Power BI reports (type PowerBIReport, workspaceId, itemId)
Binds relationship endpoints to a LakehouseTable via source/target key ref bindings (arrays support composite keys)

flags.--dir: Directory with Fabric ontology structure (EntityTypes/, RelationshipTypes/)
flags.--decode: Add decodedPayload field to get-definition output

notes: Data binding sourceType must be FIRST key in sourceTableProperties (JSON key ordering WITHIN a binding matters!)
Data binding IDs must be valid UUIDs (non-UUID values are silently dropped)
Entity types support inheritance via baseEntityTypeId; fabio import maps rdfs:subClassOf to it
Static attributes go in properties; measurements-over-time go in timeseriesProperties (bound by a TimeSeries data binding); untypedProperties use valueType Any

UNTYPED properties (valueType Any) are NOT bindable: they belong only under entityType.untypedProperties and must NEVER appear in a DataBinding's propertyBindings. Binding one makes updateDefinition fail with the generic ALMOperationImportFailed. fabio import excludes them automatically.
dataBindingType is NonTimeSeries (LakehouseTable only) or TimeSeries (LakehouseTable or KustoTable, requires timestampColumnName)
Relationship contextualizations bind only to LakehouseTable; key ref bindings are arrays (composite keys); sourceEntityTypeId/targetEntityTypeId must match the relationship's endpoints
Property value types: String, Boolean, DateTime, Object, BigInt, Double (untyped: Any)
Entity type required: id, namespace ('usertypes'), name, namespaceType ('Custom')
Documents/Overviews/ResourceLinks are optional entity metadata; import generates Documents/ResourceLinks from RDF annotations, and all three pass through via --dir

updateDefinition validates ALL parts together and, on failure, returns a generic 'ALMOperationImportFailed' (top-level message is often an unfilled '{0} {1} {2}' template; the real reason is in error.errorCode + error.moreDetails). Likely causes, in order: (1) an untyped property in a binding, (2) a binding/contextualization referencing an entityTypeId/propertyId/relationshipTypeId not defined in the same push (IDs are case-sensitive), (3) a TimeSeries binding missing timestampColumn, (4) a malformed part ($schema/required field/mismatched contextualization endpoints).

Fabric does NOT validate that referenced Lakehouse tables/columns exist at updateDefinition time — that is deferred to query time. A binding to a non-existent table still imports successfully, so a missing table is never the cause of ALMOperationImportFailed.
Neither .platform nor part ordering across files is required for updateDefinition (interleaved vs defs-first both work); only key order WITHIN a single DataBinding matters.

Convention bind (import/bind without a per-entity timestampColumn) fails for any time-series entity: 'Entity X has a TimeSeries binding but no timestampColumn'. Supply timestampColumn (import --entities map or bind config) or use a non-time-series entity.
Ontology requires a capacity with the Ontology/Digital Twin Builder preview enabled; create/import/getDefinition each take ~60-100s (LRO).
